Recognize statically named global built-in owners in the experimental minifier, including literal computed paths and known `Object`/`Reflect` writers.

```javascript
globalThis.Math.abs = function () {
	return 99;
};
console.log(Math.abs(-1));
```

| Execution                       | Output |
| ------------------------------- | ------ |
| Original program                | `99`   |
| Faulty experimental minifier    | `1`    |
| Corrected experimental minifier | `99`   |

Reuse direct-owner recognition to block unsafe folding after mutations while retaining unrelated folds. This restores #22862 behavior regressed in #23110; #23133 handled computed writer names. Dynamic outer owners such as `globalThis[key].abs` remain unsupported.
